span.p:
1. Hold ALL XSHUT LOW at boot.
2. Release Front, write 0x30.
3. Release Side, write 0x31.
(See vl53l1x_dual.h)

span.p:
⚠ Both AS5600 = 0x36 fixed.
Dual-bus topology resolves it
WITHOUT TCA9548A mux.
